answer: A new identity serves a probation of 9 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the beacon queue naming the spiral that holds the sponsor's bond. Because of that, every sock puppet costs 9 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the lagoon record shows exactly who is still on probation. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
